name: Chiseled Enchanting Table (Unofficial 26.1.2 Port)
description: Unofficial community port of Sacramentix's Chiseled Enchanting Table to Minecraft 26.1.2 / Fabric. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the original author. A rework of enchantment progression: you can now enchant your gear using enchanted books placed in nearby chiseled bookshelves using a chiseled enchanting table.

custom.chiseled_enchanting_table:port_notes: Unofficial community port to Minecraft 26.1.2. 1.0.3 syncs the 26.3 branch's fixes and features onto this line: the worldgen bookshelf deadlock fix (structure bookshelves are now filled from the StructureBlockInfo, never from the live level off the server thread, so template-placed chiseled bookshelves are actually filled and chunk generation can no longer freeze the integrated server), server-authoritative enchantment costs synced to the client on join and after every data-pack reload, optional JEI and REI integration (bidirectional enchanted-book <-> item lookup over one shared index), translatable book lore, and 11 shipped languages. Still 26.1.2-native, deliberately NOT taken from the 26.3 branch: StructureProcessor as an abstract class with getType(), ChunkAccess#markPosForPostprocessing spelling, the ConstantValue/LootPoolSingletonContainer loot builder API, List<LootItemCondition> conditional loot functions, FriendlyByteBuf collection helpers, the per-block MapCodec, LivingEntity#drop(ItemStack, boolean), the plural loot_table schema (conditions[]/functions[] dispatched on condition/function) and recipe_crafted 'recipe_id'. 1.0.2 base: JSON-driven chest / archaeology loot injection, live structure bookshelf replacement/fill, score-based shelf-facing, vanilla-anvil-style XP point deduction, restored vanilla enchanting-table book blocking, restored narrow anvil book+book same-level merge blocking, and restored enchanted-book chiseled-bookshelf random-tick particles/sound. Active mixins live in chiseled-enchanting-table-port.mixins.json. Still parked: broader anvil XP-cost tweak, Colorful Books integration, enchanted-book stack-size accessor, and remaining visual/advancement polish. See CURRENT_BASELINE.md for the full capability boundary, docs/reports/SYNC_FROM_26_3_REPORT.md for what was synced from the 26.3 branch and what was adapted, and docs/EXTENDING.md for data-driven customisation entry points.
